# Objetivo

Crear una primera vista visual del dataset de ventas de Balaji Fast Food: distribucion de variables principales y ventas agregadas por fecha, mes, producto, tipo de producto, tipo de pago y persona que recibe.

El CSV original no se modifica. La limpieza se hace en memoria dentro de este Rmd.

# Carga y limpieza minima

```{r load-data}
raw_path <- "../Balaji Fast Food Sales.csv"
ventas <- read.csv(raw_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# Guardamos la fecha original para trazabilidad.
ventas$date_original <- ventas$date

# El dataset mezcla fechas con '-' y con '/'. Primero unificamos separador.
ventas$date_standardized <- gsub("-", "/", trimws(ventas$date_original), fixed = TRUE)

# Segun el rango observado, la lectura coherente es mes/dia/anio.
ventas$date <- as.Date(ventas$date_standardized, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Limpiamos espacios en variables categoricas.
categorical_cols <- c("item_name", "item_type", "transaction_type", "received_by", "time_of_sale")
for (col in categorical_cols) {
  ventas[[col]] <- trimws(ventas[[col]])
}

# Los nulos o vacios de transaction_type se mantienen como categoria explicita.
ventas$transaction_type[is.na(ventas$transaction_type) | ventas$transaction_type == ""] <- "Unknown"

# Comprobaciones basicas.
stopifnot(sum(is.na(ventas$date)) == 0)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(ventas$transaction_type)) == 0)

str(ventas)
```

# Resumen rapido

```{r quick-summary}
summary_table <- data.frame(
  metrica = c(
    "filas",
    "columnas",
    "fecha_minima",
    "fecha_maxima",
    "ventas_totales_importe",
    "unidades_totales",
    "ticket_medio"
  ),
  valor = c(
    nrow(ventas),
    ncol(ventas),
    as.character(min(ventas$date)),
    as.character(max(ventas$date)),
    sum(ventas$transaction_amount),
    sum(ventas$quantity),
    round(mean(ventas$transaction_amount), 2)
  )
)
summary_table
```

```{r helpers}
plot_bar <- function(values, title, xlab = "", ylab = "", col = "#4E79A7", las = 2) {
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  par(mar = c(8, 5, 4, 2))
  barplot(
    values,
    main = title,
    xlab = xlab,
    ylab = ylab,
    col = col,
    border = "white",
    las = las
  )
}

plot_sorted_bar <- function(df, label_col, value_col, title, ylab = "Importe vendido") {
  df <- df[order(df[[value_col]], decreasing = TRUE), ]
  values <- setNames(df[[value_col]], df[[label_col]])
  plot_bar(values, title = title, ylab = ylab, col = "#59A14F")
}
```

# Distribucion de variables principales

Estos graficos cuentan cuantas filas/ventas hay por categoria. Sirven para ver la composicion del dataset antes de mirar importes.

```{r item-name-counts}
plot_bar(sort(table(ventas$item_name), decreasing = TRUE),
         title = "Numero de ventas por producto",
         ylab = "Numero de filas / ventas",
         col = "#4E79A7")
```

```{r item-type-counts}
plot_bar(sort(table(ventas$item_type), decreasing = TRUE),
         title = "Numero de ventas por tipo de producto",
         ylab = "Numero de filas / ventas",
         col = "#F28E2B")
```

```{r payment-type-counts}
plot_bar(sort(table(ventas$transaction_type), decreasing = TRUE),
         title = "Numero de ventas por tipo de pago",
         ylab = "Numero de filas / ventas",
         col = "#E15759")
```

```{r received-by-counts}
plot_bar(sort(table(ventas$received_by), decreasing = TRUE),
         title = "Numero de ventas por persona que recibe",
         ylab = "Numero de filas / ventas",
         col = "#76B7B2")
```

```{r time-of-sale-counts}
time_order <- c("Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening", "Night", "Midnight")
time_counts <- table(factor(ventas$time_of_sale, levels = time_order))
plot_bar(time_counts,
         title = "Numero de ventas por franja horaria",
         ylab = "Numero de filas / ventas",
         col = "#B07AA1")
```

# Ventas por dia y por mes

Para el dia uso linea porque hay muchos dias y una barra por dia queda poco legible. Para mes uso barras.

```{r daily-sales}
daily_sales <- aggregate(transaction_amount ~ date, data = ventas, sum)
daily_sales <- daily_sales[order(daily_sales$date), ]

old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
plot(
  daily_sales$date,
  daily_sales$transaction_amount,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  col = "#4E79A7",
  main = "Importe vendido por dia",
  xlab = "Fecha",
  ylab = "Importe vendido"
)
points(daily_sales$date, daily_sales$transaction_amount, pch = 16, cex = 0.45, col = "#4E79A7")
par(old_par)

head(daily_sales, 10)
```

```{r monthly-sales}
ventas$month <- as.Date(format(ventas$date, "%Y-%m-01"))
monthly_sales <- aggregate(transaction_amount ~ month, data = ventas, sum)
monthly_sales <- monthly_sales[order(monthly_sales$month), ]

monthly_values <- setNames(monthly_sales$transaction_amount, format(monthly_sales$month, "%Y-%m"))
plot_bar(monthly_values,
         title = "Importe vendido por mes",
         ylab = "Importe vendido",
         col = "#59A14F")

monthly_sales
```

# Ventas por tipo de pago

```{r sales-by-payment}
sales_by_payment <- aggregate(transaction_amount ~ transaction_type, data = ventas, sum)
plot_sorted_bar(sales_by_payment,
                label_col = "transaction_type",
                value_col = "transaction_amount",
                title = "Importe vendido por tipo de pago")
sales_by_payment[order(sales_by_payment$transaction_amount, decreasing = TRUE), ]
```


```{r sales-by-received-by}

plot_sorted_bar(sales_by_received,
```

# Ventas por franja horaria

```{r sales-by-time-of-sale}
sales_by_time <- aggregate(transaction_amount ~ time_of_sale, data = ventas, sum)
sales_by_time$time_of_sale <- factor(sales_by_time$time_of_sale, levels = time_order)
sales_by_time <- sales_by_time[order(sales_by_time$time_of_sale), ]

values <- setNames(sales_by_time$transaction_amount, sales_by_time$time_of_sale)
plot_bar(values,
         title = "Importe vendido por franja horaria",
         ylab = "Importe vendido",
         col = "#B07AA1")
sales_by_time
```

# Lectura inicial

```{r interpretation, echo=FALSE}
cat("- Producto con mayor importe vendido:", sales_by_product$item_name[which.max(sales_by_product$transaction_amount)], "\n")
cat("- Tipo de producto con mayor importe vendido:", sales_by_item_type$item_type[which.max(sales_by_item_type$transaction_amount)], "\n")
cat("- Tipo de pago con mayor importe vendido:", sales_by_payment$transaction_type[which.max(sales_by_payment$transaction_amount)], "\n")
cat("- Persona que recibe con mayor importe vendido:", sales_by_received$received_by[which.max(sales_by_received$transaction_amount)], "\n")
cat("- Mes con mayor importe vendido:", format(monthly_sales$month[which.max(monthly_sales$transaction_amount)], "%Y-%m"), "\n")
```
